source_label: UDK Strength of Schedule by Position — 18-week opponent schedule
extracted: mechanical CSV ingest from UDK site exports (build/ingest_supplemental.py)
notes: TEAM-grain, not player-grain: these rows do not join on player_id and are deliberately kept out of the player canonical.
One row per team per position (32 teams x 4 positions = 128 rows).
'opp_pts_allowed' is the opponent's points allowed to this position. A BYE week is recorded as opp='BYE' with 0 values.
